content.value_statement: JavaScript projects need tests that cover logic, APIs, UI behavior, and regressions. This skill provides practical Jest, Vitest, Testing Library, mocking, fixture, and integration patterns.
actual_capabilities: Configures Jest and Vitest test setups with coverage thresholds and setup files.
Shows unit testing patterns for pure functions, classes, async functions, and errors.
Demonstrates mocks for fetch, modules, email services, repositories, spies, and timers.
Covers API and database integration tests with Supertest, PostgreSQL pools, and cleanup hooks.
Guides React component and hook tests with Testing Library queries and user interactions.
Includes fixtures, factories, snapshots, coverage scripts, and test organization practices.
limitations: It provides patterns and examples, not a complete test suite for a specific repository.
Examples use placeholder services, users, databases, and URLs that must be adapted.
It does not run tests or verify that project dependencies are installed.
It focuses on JavaScript and TypeScript, not other languages or test ecosystems.

use_cases.title: Start Project Testing
use_cases.description: Set up Jest or Vitest with coverage rules, setup files, and a clear folder strategy.

use_cases.title: Improve API Confidence
use_cases.description: Add integration tests for API routes, authentication, validation, persistence, and cleanup behavior.

use_cases.title: Standardize Team Patterns
use_cases.description: Give a team consistent examples for mocks, fixtures, snapshots, hooks, and component tests.

prompt_templates.title: Write Unit Tests
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner prompt for a single function or class.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to write Vitest unit tests for this function. Cover normal cases, edge cases, and errors. Explain the test structure.

prompt_templates.title: Test a Component
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to test this React component with Testing Library. Prefer accessible queries, cover user input, and avoid implementation details.

prompt_templates.title: Design Integration Coverage
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate prompt for API and database behavior.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to design integration tests for these API routes. Include setup, cleanup, authentication, validation, and expected response cases.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a TDD Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced prompt for a feature or refactor.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to create a TDD plan for this feature. Define test layers, mocks, fixtures, coverage goals, and regression checks before implementation.

output_examples.input: A user service needs tests for create, update, duplicate email, and missing user cases.
output_examples.output: A focused unit test plan with setup hooks, repository mocks, success cases, error cases, and assertions for repository calls.

output_examples.input: An Express API needs confidence around signup, login, protected routes, and database cleanup.
output_examples.output: An integration test outline covering Supertest requests, authentication flow, invalid input, duplicate data, table setup, and teardown.

output_examples.input: A React form needs tests for rendering, field updates, submit behavior, and validation messages.
output_examples.output: A component testing checklist using accessible queries, simulated user input, submit assertions, and visible error-state expectations.

best_practices: Test observable behavior and user outcomes before private implementation details.
Use mocks for external services while keeping important integration paths covered.
Keep setup and fixtures reusable so tests stay readable and isolated.
anti_patterns: Do not assert every internal method call when a behavior assertion is clearer.
Do not share mutable test data across cases without cleanup.
Do not rely on real third-party services in routine unit tests.

faq.question: Does this skill support both Jest and Vitest?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes setup and testing examples for both frameworks.

faq.question: Can it help with React component tests?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers Testing Library patterns for rendering, queries, input changes, and submit behavior.

faq.question: Does it include API integration testing?
faq.answer: Yes. It shows Supertest examples for routes, authentication, validation, and response checks.

faq.question: Will it create project-specific fixtures automatically?
faq.answer: No. It gives fixture and factory patterns that must be adapted to the project data model.

faq.question: Does it require live external services?
faq.answer: No. The examples favor mocks and local integration targets for repeatable tests.

faq.question: Can Claude, Codex, and Claude Code use it?
faq.answer: Yes. The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
